name: MISC Berhad
oneLine: A shipping company that carries oil and gas across the world and owns floating facilities used in offshore oil and gas production.
inPlainWords: MISC owns large ships. Energy companies hire them to move gas, crude oil and petroleum products over long distances.
It also owns floating production assets that sit at offshore oil and gas fields, and a marine and heavy engineering arm that builds offshore structures and repairs and converts ships.
It has 108 gas and petroleum vessels and 12 offshore floating production assets, and operates in 11 countries.

flow.label: Energy companies
flow.detail: Oil and gas producers need their cargo moved or their offshore fields supported.

flow.label: Contracts
flow.detail: They hire MISC's ships and offshore assets. The company says its portfolio is supported by long-term contracted assets.

flow.label: 108 vessels, 12 offshore assets
flow.detail: MISC earns income from the hire while it pays for crew, fuel and upkeep.

flow.label: Engineering yard
flow.detail: Separately earns from offshore construction, marine repair and conversion work.

moneyNote: Petroleum and Products shipping is the largest segment, with RM5.2 billion revenue and RM1.4 billion operating profit in 2025.
